name: Applause® Honeycomb Shades
description: Applause® Honeycomb Shades feature a unique two-cell construction that provides extra insulation and a sophisticated look with an extensive palette of colors.

benefits.text:
Simplified Offering
Easily find your perfect Applause® shade with a streamlined selection 
of pleat sizes, opacities and operating systems. 
Care and Cleaning
To ensure lasting beauty, all Applause shades are anti-static, 
dust and soil resistent, and easy to clean.
Specialty Shapes
From arches to angles to trapezoids, Applause shades can cover a 
wide variety of window shapes and sizes. 
Sustainability
The Applause Vintage™ fabric collection is innovatively crafted 
with 40% recycled materials.
Noise Reduction
Applause® shades absorb sound energy, helping to create 
a more tranquil room.
Benefits
Durable Headrail Finishes
Textured matte headrails are color coordinated to the 
fabric for a cohesive design.
Expansive Sizes, Small Stack
Applause shades are engineered to fit expansive windows with 
minimal stack, allowing for unobstructed views.
Stylish Fabrics
Choose from an on-trend collection of fabrics in a 
contemporary color palette.

Cost Savings
Shades help control the indoor temperature, so you can spend less 
to heat and cool your home. 
Insulation

from harsh outdoor temperatures.
Automation Throughout the Year

to the sun’s movements, so your home’s temperature is regulated automatically.

PowerView® Automation

Simplicity™** 
This manual system is designed for skylights and other hard-to-reach windows. 
Can be oriented for top, bottom or side stack.
Vertiglide Traveling Center Stack 
Shades open from the sides and close from the center. 

Vertiglide Split Stack 
Shades operate individually.
SkyLift™*  
This system covers large skylights. Available with manual or 
motorized operation, and in top stack only.
Vertiglide Right Stack 
Right stack opens from left to right.

Vertiglide™
For vertical applications such as patio doors, this system provides side-to-side 
operation. Offered in four stacking configurations.
Additional Operating Options
Vertiglide™ Left Stack
Left stack opens from right to left.
*Available in Canada as a Duolite® option only.
**Not available in Canada.
EasyView™ Arch**  
Manual system for arched shaped window openings. An optional 
extension pole is available for hard-to-reach windows.

Room Darkening

Operating System LiteRise®  
Room Darkening

Room Darkening
Blocks most incoming light with maximum privacy 
Sheer
Provides the most natural light and view-through with minimal privacy 
Light Filtering
Gently filters light and offers moderate privacy 
Duolite® Dual Opacity Design Option
Features two opacities in one shade 
Light Control and Privacy
Fabric Crystalline™ Sheer    Color Rock Crystal
Fabric Legends™    Color Pearl
Operating System PowerView® Automation, Vertiglide™ Split Stack 
Design Option Duolite®

Duolite® with Sheer
Combine a sheer fabric with a light-filtering or room-darkening fabric 
in a single shade. 
Duolite with Light Filtering
Combine a light-filtering fabric with a room-darkening fabric 
in a single shade. 
Duolite® Design Option
Fabric Crystalline™ Sheer    Color Rock Crystal
Fabric Vintage™    Color Aged Onyx
Operating System PowerView® Automation 
Design Option Duolite®

Dual Opacity
The Duolite® design option combines two opacities in one shade. 
The exposed middle moving rail allows you to easily cover larger windows.
Two-On-One Headrail
Two independently operated shades can share the same headrail.
Sidelights
Operable and non-operable Applause shades are available for sidelights. 
(Operable sidelights not available in Canada) 
Double Cell
Conserve more energy at the window with a double-cell construction.
Top-Down/Bottom-Up
Open the shade from the top or bottom for a greater range 
of light control. (Top-Down/Bottom-Up is not available in Canada) 
Specialty Shapes
Cover windows in your home that have unusual shapes or sizes.
Design Options
French Doors
Applause® shades are a perfect solution for French doors. Secure the 
bottom rail with magnetic hold-down brackets.
